get_game_config: use PrivateComputationGameRepository get_game to retrieve an MPCGameConfig for a supported game name like lift
list_game_names: inspect the GameNames enum to list all supported private computation game types such as pcf2_lift
review_game_config_dict: review the PRIVATE_COMPUTATION_GAME_CONFIG dictionary to see onedocker package names and arguments for each game
check_one_docker_argument: check the OneDockerArgument dataclass to understand the name and required fields for game arguments
validate_game_support: validate a game name by calling get_game and catching ValueError for unsupported game names
